name: entity-usage
goal: An entity shows what uses it under Used In and what it uses under Uses, in the Reports explorer and the shared workspace; nothing is called Relationships and old addresses still open both

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Entity views said Relationships: the Reports explorer had a Relationships tab of six cards (Components, Functions, Configs, Services, Used on pages, Used by) and a config pane with its own Used by list; the workspace had a Relationships tab and panel labelled Uses and Used by per row. Wanted: sections named exactly Used In and Uses on every kind, on the overview and at tabs of their own, no source path, former addresses still opening both. Spec: specification/features/planned/entity-usage.md. Graph, index and recorded relationships are not changed.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Frozen before product edits (frozen-tests.sha256, frozen-tests-2.sha256). Unchanged 139359e: reports test/entity-usage.test.ts 6 failed; desktop test/entity-usage.test.ts 4 failed; desktop ui-entity-usage.spec.ts 3 failed; reports harness-explorer-usage.spec.ts 3 failed. One assertion of that spec asked an absent card for its text; corrected (frozen-correction.diff, original kept) and rerun on an isolated copy of 139359e with the new kinds spec: 7 failed (red/reports-browser-corrected-RED-on-base.log). Config pane, before it was touched: test/entity-usage-kinds.test.ts 2 failed, 1 control passed. Before pictures inspected: before/, before-corrected/.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reports: EntityRelations draws Used In and Uses from the new util entityUsage; EntityOverview holds both, compact; EntitySections shows one at ?tab=used-in or ?tab=uses and the overview for any other tab, the former relationships one too; EntityHeader names the tabs; EntityConfig drops its duplicate Used by list; explorerRoute reads the two new tabs and still reads relationships. Workspace: RelationshipsPanel lists one side with kind badges or by kind; EntityView has sections Used In and Uses and both on the overview; workspaceRoute reads used-in and uses. Older tests changed only where a label or count changed on purpose (final/old-expectations.diff).

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen files: reports unit 11 passed; desktop unit 4 passed; reports browser 27 passed with the corrected usage spec, the kinds spec at three widths, the existing explorer specs and the console scenario spec of 34 states; desktop browser 27 passed with the viewports spec. Mutants at load time, 13, each rejected; controls pass (guard/summary.txt). Suites: reports 485, desktop 602 and 3 skipped. Types, lint, format, audit of both packages and root types pass; units check 1196, scenarios check 18, explain check 20 reasons. After pictures inspected at desktop, tablet and phone widths: after/, after-corrected/. No compiled, stamped scenario run was made.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
